sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: Enable extensions and create schemas
sections.what: Turns on the vector and uuid-ossp extensions and creates six schemas for corpus, surveys, studies, panels, analytics and audit data.
sections.why: Likely reason: separate schemas keep each data area organized, and the vector extension supports document search.
sections.watch_out: The database must include the vector extension, or the script fails at the start.

sections.name: ALTER
sections.title: Set search path and grant access
sections.what: Sets the default schema search order for the database and gives the app user full rights on each schema, its existing tables and its sequences.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the app use short table names and have full access without manual setup.
sections.watch_out: Grants cover only existing tables, so new tables may need grants added.

summary: A setup script that enables two database extensions, creates six schemas for the app's data areas, and gives the app's database user full access.
purpose: Prepares the database so the app can store corpus, survey, study, panel, analytics and audit data.
why: Likely reason: separate schemas keep data areas organized. The vector extension likely supports similarity search over documents.
how: Enables the vector and uuid-ossp extensions, creates the schemas, sets the default search path for the database, then grants the user all rights on each schema, its tables and its sequences.
inputs: A database named research_platform and a user named platform_user.
risks: The grants cover only tables that already exist. Tables created later may need new grants, unless default privileges are set elsewhere. Search path applies to the database as a whole.
debug: If the script fails at the start, check that the database image includes the vector extension. If the app cannot write to a new table, check its grants. If names do not resolve, check the search path.
